flashcards.definitionZh: 晚餐时间
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“用餐”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Citrus fruit variant of jam but distinguished by being made slightly bitter by the addition of the peel and by partial caramelisation during manufacture. Most commonly made with Seville oranges, and usually qualified by the name of the fruit when made with other types of fruit.
flashcards.example: lime marmalade
flashcards.definitionZh: 果酱的柑橘类水果变种，但其特点是在制造过程中添加果皮和部分焦糖化，使其略带苦味。最常见的是用塞维利亚橙子制成的，当用其他类型的水果制成时，通常用水果的名称来限定。
flashcards.exampleZh: 酸橙果酱

flashcards.definition: Blockage, congestion.
flashcards.example: A traffic jam caused us to miss the game's first period.
flashcards.definitionZh: 阻塞、拥堵。
flashcards.exampleZh: 由于交通堵塞，我们错过了第一节比赛。

flashcards.definition: An edible fruit produced by the pear tree, similar to an apple but elongated towards the stem.
flashcards.example: This is the word Pear.
flashcards.definitionZh: 梨树产生的可食用水果，类似于苹果，但向茎部延伸。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是梨这个词。

flashcards.definition: Choice; especially lavish or preferred.
flashcards.example: She landed a plum position as an executive for the firm.
flashcards.definitionZh: 选择;特别奢侈或首选。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她在公司获得了一个不错的高管职位。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: To be very happy, be delighted, exult; to feel joy.
flashcards.example: This is the word Rejoice.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常高兴、高兴、狂喜；感受到快乐。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是喜乐这个词。

flashcards.definition: An instance of having won a competition or battle or succeeded in an effort.
flashcards.example: It was a great victory on the battlefield.
flashcards.definitionZh: 赢得比赛或战斗或努力取得成功的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是战场上的伟大胜利。

flashcards.definition: To cut anything in this fashion.
flashcards.example: The labourer with the bending scythe is seen / Shaving the surface of the waving green.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以这种方式切割任何东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 可以看到拿着弯镰刀的劳动者/正在修剪波浪状果岭的表面。

flashcards.definition: A conceptual device that allows one to shave away unlikely explanations for a phenomenon.
flashcards.example: Occam's razor, Hanlon's razor
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种概念手段，可以让人们消除对某种现象不太可能的解释。
flashcards.exampleZh: 奥卡姆剃刀、汉隆剃刀

flashcards.definition: To make better from a disease, wound, etc.; to revive or cure.
flashcards.example: This bandage will heal your cut.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使疾病、伤口等康复；使之复活或治愈。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这绷带可以治愈你的伤口。

flashcards.definition: To be alive; to have life.
flashcards.example: He's not expected to live for more than a few months.
flashcards.definitionZh: 活着；拥有生命。
flashcards.exampleZh: 预计他的寿命不会超过几个月。

flashcards.definition: To be alive; to have life.
flashcards.example: He's not expected to live for more than a few months.
flashcards.definitionZh: 活着；拥有生命。
flashcards.exampleZh: 预计他的寿命不会超过几个月。

flashcards.definition: A composer, conductor, or performer of music; specifically, a person who sings and/or plays a musical instrument as a hobby, an occupation, or a profession.
flashcards.example: This is the word Musician.
flashcards.definitionZh: 音乐作曲家、指挥家或表演者；具体来说，是以唱歌和/或演奏乐器作为爱好、职业或职业的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是音乐家这个词。

flashcards.definition: Gentle and not easily angered.
flashcards.example: a mild man
flashcards.definitionZh: 性情温和，不易生气。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个温和的人

flashcards.definition: An expression, in speech or writing, of something remarked or noticed; a mention of something
flashcards.example: a biting remark
flashcards.definitionZh: 言语或书面表达的某事的评论或注意到；提及某事
flashcards.exampleZh: 尖刻的话

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word look at.
flashcards.example: This is the word look at.
flashcards.definitionZh: 看这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是看这个词。

flashcards.definition: Characterized by, or proceeding from, a storm; subject to storms; agitated with strong winds and heavy rain.
flashcards.example: a stormy season or a stormy day
flashcards.definitionZh: 以风暴为特征或源自风暴；遭受暴风雨；狂风大雨。
flashcards.exampleZh: 暴风雨的季节或暴风雨的日子

flashcards.definition: Used in proving or testing.
flashcards.example: a proof load; a proof charge
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于证明或测试。
flashcards.exampleZh: 验证负载；证明费用

flashcards.definition: To pronounce.
flashcards.example: Please say your name slowly and clearly.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请缓慢而清晰地说出你的名字。

flashcards.definition: A machine or other device designed to catch (and sometimes kill) animals, either by holding them in a container, or by catching hold of part of the body.
flashcards.example: I put down some traps in my apartment to try and deal with the mouse problem.
flashcards.definitionZh: 设计用于捕捉（有时杀死）动物的机器或其他装置，或者将它们放在容器中，或者抓住身体的一部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我在公寓里设置了一些陷阱来尝试解决老鼠问题。

flashcards.definition: Ruin or deterioration.
flashcards.example: After his arrest, his prospects went to pot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 毁坏或恶化。
flashcards.exampleZh: 被捕后，他的前景一片黯淡。

flashcards.definition: To prepare (food) for eating by heating it, often by combining it with other ingredients.
flashcards.example: I'm cooking bangers and mash.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过加热（通常与其他成分混合）来准备（食物）供食用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我正在煮香肠和土豆泥。

flashcards.definition: A pot filled with soil in which plants are grown.
flashcards.example: This is the word Flowerpot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个装满土壤的花盆，里面可以种植植物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是花盆这个词。

flashcards.definition: The end of a meal, when coffee is served.
flashcards.example: He did not stay for coffee.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用餐结束，咖啡上桌时。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有留下来喝咖啡。

flashcards.definition: A vessel for brewing and serving tea.
flashcards.example: This is the word Teapot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 泡茶和盛茶的器皿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是茶壶这个词。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: A romantic or sexual involvement.
flashcards.example: They have been in a relationship for ten years, but have never married.
flashcards.definitionZh: 浪漫或性的参与。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们恋爱了十年，但从未结婚。

flashcards.definition: Someone in the same family; someone connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.
flashcards.example: Why do my relatives always talk about sex?
flashcards.definitionZh: 同一个家庭中的某个人；因血缘、婚姻或收养而有联系的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为什么我的亲戚总是谈论性？

flashcards.definition: (investment) A security or class of securities in which one has a heavy concentration.
flashcards.example: Apple common stock is one of our overweights.
flashcards.definitionZh: （投资）高度集中的一种证券或一类证券。
flashcards.exampleZh: 苹果普通股是我们增持的股票之一。

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: A contest, especially for spelling; see spelling bee.
flashcards.example: geography bee
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场比赛，尤其是拼写比赛；参见拼字比赛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 地理蜜蜂

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: Adjacent, near, close by
flashcards.example: He stopped at a nearby store for some groceries.
flashcards.definitionZh: 邻近、附近、附近
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在附近的一家商店停下来买了一些杂货。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: A means of exit, escape, reprieve, etc.
flashcards.example: They wrote the law to give those organizations an out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 退出、逃脱、缓刑等的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们制定了法律来给这些组织一个机会。

flashcards.definition: A continued theme or idea.
flashcards.example: All of these essays have a common thread.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个持续的主题或想法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 所有这些文章都有一个共同的主线。

flashcards.definition: A fine, sharp implement usually for piercing such as sewing, or knitting, acupuncture, tattooing, body piercing, medical injections, etc.
flashcards.example: The seamstress threaded the needle to sew on a button.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种精细、锋利的工具，通常用于穿刺，例如缝纫、针织、针灸、纹身、身体穿刺、医疗注射等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 女裁缝将针穿过，缝上纽扣。

flashcards.definition: To use a needle to pass thread repeatedly through (pieces of fabric) in order to join them together.
flashcards.example: Balls were first made of grass or leaves held together by strings, and later of pieces of animal skin sewn together and stuffed with feathers or hay.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使用针将线反复穿过（布料）以将它们连接在一起。
flashcards.exampleZh: 球最初是用草或树叶用绳子绑在一起制成的，后来又用动物皮片缝合在一起并填充羽毛或干草制成。

flashcards.definition: An enclosing limit; a boundary, a circumference.
flashcards.example: within the compass of an encircling wall
flashcards.definitionZh: 封闭限制；边界，圆周。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在围墙的范围内

flashcards.definition: The supply of additional funding to a person or a business.
flashcards.example: The troubled business received a much-needed cash injection.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向个人或企业提供额外资金。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这家陷入困境的企业获得了急需的现金注入。

flashcards.definition: One who exerts power, or has the power to act
flashcards.example: This is the word Agent.
flashcards.definitionZh: 行使权力或有权力采取行动的人
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是代理这个词。

flashcards.definition: The capacity of individuals to act independently and to make their own free choices.
flashcards.example: individual agency
flashcards.definitionZh: 个人独立行动并做出自己自由选择的能力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 个体代理机构

flashcards.definition: Legal right to ownership of a property; a deed or other certificate proving this.
flashcards.example: a good title to an estate, or an imperfect title
flashcards.definitionZh: 财产所有权的合法权利；证明这一点的契约或其他证书。
flashcards.exampleZh: 良好的遗产所有权，或不完善的所有权

flashcards.definition: An ongoing winner in a game or contest.
flashcards.example: The defending champion is expected to defeat his challenger.
flashcards.definitionZh: 游戏或竞赛中持续获胜的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 卫冕冠军有望击败挑战者。

flashcards.definition: A participant (fighter) in a boxing match.
flashcards.example: You can tell she's a boxer by looking at her nose.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拳击比赛的参与者（拳击手）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 看她的鼻子就知道她是拳击手。

flashcards.definition: Deviating from the norm; unusual, extraordinary.
flashcards.example: This is the word Enormous.
flashcards.definitionZh: 偏离常态；不寻常的，非凡的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“巨大”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Mental acceptance of a claim as true.
flashcards.example: It's my belief that the thief is somebody known to us.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在心理上接受某个主张是真实的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我相信小偷是我们认识的人。

flashcards.definition: The work involved in performing an activity; exertion.
flashcards.example: It took a lot of effort to find a decent-sized, fully-furnished apartment within walking distance of the office.   He made a conscious effort to not appear affected by the stories in the paper.
flashcards.definitionZh: 执行某项活动所涉及的工作；用力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 费了九牛二虎之力，才在办公室步行范围内找到了一套面积合适、家具齐全的公寓。   他有意识地努力不让自己显得受到报纸上报道的影响。

flashcards.definition: Continuance or a period of time spent in a place; abode for an indefinite time; sojourn.
flashcards.example: I hope you enjoyed your stay in Hawaii.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在一个地方持续或度过一段时间；无限期居住；寄居。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我希望您在夏威夷过得愉快。

flashcards.definition: To accept hardship without objection.
flashcards.example: I can tolerate working on Saturdays, but not on Sundays.
flashcards.definitionZh: 接受困难而不反对。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我可以忍受周六工作，但不能忍受周日工作。

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: Factually right, correct; factual.
flashcards.example: It is a just assessment of the facts.
flashcards.definitionZh: 事实正确，正确；事实。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是对事实的公正评估。

flashcards.definition: A substance or preparation in which something is immersed.
flashcards.example: a bath of heated sand, ashes, steam, or hot air
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某物浸入其中的物质或制剂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 加热的沙子、灰烬、蒸汽或热空气浴

flashcards.definition: The act of swimming or bathing, especially in the sea, a lake, or a river; a swimming bath.
flashcards.example: I'm going to have a midnight bathe tonight.
flashcards.definitionZh: 游泳或沐浴的行为，尤其是在海、湖或河中；一个游泳池。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今晚我要洗个半夜澡。

flashcards.definition: A sunbathing session: a sunbath.
flashcards.example: Do you think it's warm enough outside for a sunbathe?
flashcards.definitionZh: 日光浴：日光浴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你认为外面足够暖和可以晒日光浴吗？

flashcards.definition: To violate rules in order to gain advantage from a situation.
flashcards.example: My brother flunked biology because he cheated on his mid-term.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为了从某种情况中获得利益而违反规则。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我哥哥生物没及格，因为他期中考试作弊。

flashcards.definition: A lower section of a road or geological feature.
flashcards.example: There is a dip in the road ahead.
flashcards.definitionZh: 道路或地质特征的较低部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 前面的路有一个下坡。

flashcards.definition: The visible horizontal line or point (in all directions) that appears to connect the Earth to the sky.
flashcards.example: A tall building was visible on the horizon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 连接地球和天空的可见水平线或点（在所有方向）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 地平线上可见一座高楼。

flashcards.definition: Pertaining to the horizon
flashcards.example: 1667: As when the Sun new ris'n / Looks through the Horizontal misty Air — John Milton, Paradise Lost, Book 1, ll. 594-5
flashcards.definitionZh: 与地平线有关
flashcards.exampleZh: 1667 年：当太阳新升起/透过水平薄雾的空气时 — 约翰·弥尔顿，《失乐园》，第 1 册，ll。 594-5

flashcards.definition: Food given to (especially herbivorous) animals.
flashcards.example: They sell feed, riding helmets, and everything else for horses.
flashcards.wordZh: 饲料 喂 喂 喂
flashcards.definitionZh: 给（尤其是草食性）动物的食物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们出售饲料、骑马头盔和其他马匹用品。

flashcards.definition: Grass cut and dried for use as animal fodder.
flashcards.example: This is the word Hay.
flashcards.definitionZh: 草被割下来并晒干后用作动物饲料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是Hay这个词。

flashcards.definition: Made of straw.
flashcards.example: straw hat
flashcards.definitionZh: 由稻草制成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 草帽

flashcards.definition: A slender supporting member of an individual part of a plant such as a flower or a leaf; also, by analogy, the shaft of a feather.
flashcards.example: the stem of an apple or a cherry
flashcards.definitionZh: 植物个别部分（例如花或叶）的细长支撑构件；同样，羽毛的轴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 苹果或樱桃的茎

flashcards.definition: The process of developing; growth, directed change.
flashcards.example: The development of this story has been slow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发展的过程；成长，定向变革。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个故事的发展很缓慢。

flashcards.definition: The selection of one thing or person over others (with the main adposition being "for" in relation to the thing or person, but possibly also "of")
flashcards.example: He has a preference for crisp wines.
flashcards.definitionZh: 选择一件事或人而不是其他人（主要介词是与该事物或人相关的“for”，但也可能是“of”）
flashcards.exampleZh: 他偏爱清爽的葡萄酒。

flashcards.definition: A characteristic style of preparing food, often associated with a place of origin.
flashcards.example: French cuisine is considered to be one of the world's most refined and elegant styles of cooking.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种特有的准备食物的方式，通常与原产地有关。
flashcards.exampleZh: 法国菜被认为是世界上最精致、最优雅的烹饪风格之一。

flashcards.definition: Senses relating to a thin, pointed object.
flashcards.example: This is the word Style.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与薄而尖的物体有关的感觉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是风格这个词。

flashcards.definition: Action given to provide assistance; aid.
flashcards.example: I need some help with my homework.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为提供援助而采取的行动；援助。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的家庭作业需要一些帮助。

flashcards.definition: An argot, the jargon of a particular class or subgroup.
flashcards.example: He had the look of a prince, but the cant of a fishmonger.
flashcards.definitionZh: 暗语，特定类别或子群体的行话。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他有着王子的相貌，却有着鱼贩的口才。

flashcards.definition: A burden; a weight to be carried.
flashcards.example: I struggled up the hill with the heavy load in my rucksack.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个负担；要携带的重量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我背着沉重的背包，艰难地爬上山。

flashcards.definition: A round vessel or cask, of greater length than breadth, and bulging in the middle, made of staves bound with hoops, and having flat ends or heads. Sometimes applied to a similar cylindrical container made of metal, usually called a drum.
flashcards.example: a cracker barrel
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种圆形容器或木桶，长度大于宽度，中间鼓起，由用箍箍住的木条制成，末端或头部平坦。有时适用于由金属制成的类似圆柱形容器，通常称为鼓。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个饼干桶

flashcards.definition: Vertical space in advance of a row or between rows of text. Also known as leading.
flashcards.example: This copy has too much lead; I prefer less space between the lines.
flashcards.definitionZh: 行前或文本行之间的垂直空间。也称为领先。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个副本的铅含量太多；我更喜欢线条之间的空间较小。

flashcards.definition: A long slender usually tapering pole used for angling; fishing rod.
flashcards.example: When I hooked a snake and not a fish, I got so scared I dropped my rod in the water.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种细长的、通常逐渐变细的竿，用于钓鱼；钓竿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当我钓到一条蛇而不是一条鱼时，我非常害怕，我把鱼竿掉进了水里。

flashcards.definition: A long journey, especially by ship.
flashcards.example: This is the word Voyage.
flashcards.definitionZh: 长途旅行，尤其是乘船。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“航程”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (heading) Of time.
flashcards.example: This is the word SPACE.
flashcards.definitionZh: （标题）时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“空间”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A journey through a particular building, estate, country, etc.
flashcards.example: On our last holiday to Spain we took a tour of the wine-growing regions.
flashcards.definitionZh: 穿越特定建筑物、庄园、国家等的旅程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在我们上次去西班牙度假时，我们参观了葡萄酒产区。

flashcards.definition: Someone who travels for pleasure rather than for business.
flashcards.example: This is the word Tourist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 出于休闲而非商务目的而旅行的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“游客”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To treat as a pet; to fondle; to indulge.
flashcards.example: His daughter was petted and spoiled.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当作宠物对待；抚摸；放纵。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的女儿被宠坏了。

flashcards.definition: A mammal of the family Leporidae, with long ears, long hind legs and a short, fluffy tail.
flashcards.example: The pioneers survived by eating the small game they could get: rabbits, squirrels and occasionally a raccoon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 兔科哺乳动物，有长耳朵、长后腿和短而毛茸茸的尾巴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 开拓者们靠吃他们能得到的小猎物生存：兔子、松鼠，偶尔还有浣熊。

flashcards.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
flashcards.example: I just got back from my morning run.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跑步、用脚快速移动的动作或实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我刚刚晨跑回来。

flashcards.definition: To bring into existence; (sometimes in particular:)
flashcards.example: You can create the color orange by mixing yellow and red.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使之存在； （有时特别是：）
flashcards.exampleZh: 您可以通过混合黄色和红色来创建橙色。

flashcards.definition: To place on or into a physical location.
flashcards.example: The statue is situated in a corner hardly visible to the public, except through a window from an outside maintenance area situated behind the building.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放置在物理位置上或内部。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这座雕像位于一个角落，公众很难看到，除非通过位于建筑物后面的外部维护区域的窗户。

flashcards.definition: (in idioms) Priesthood, clergy.
flashcards.example: He is a respected man of the cloth.
flashcards.definitionZh: （习语）神职人员，神职人员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是一位受人尊敬的布衣人。

flashcards.definition: To make someone believe, or feel sure about something, especially by using logic, argument or evidence.
flashcards.example: I wouldn't have or do something, unless I'm convinced that it's good.
flashcards.definitionZh: 让某人相信或确信某事，尤其是通过使用逻辑、论证或证据。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不会做某事，除非我确信它是好的。

flashcards.definition: An attempt.
flashcards.example: I gave unicycling a try but I couldn’t do it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次尝试。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我尝试过骑独轮车，但我做不到。

flashcards.definition: To put (something) down, to rest.
flashcards.example: Set the tray there.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放下（某物），休息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将托盘放在那里。

flashcards.definition: To ease (a person, person's thoughts etc.) from mental distress; to stop (someone) feeling anxious or worried, to alleviate the distress of.
flashcards.example: I was greatly relieved by the jury's verdict.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使（一个人、一个人的思想等）摆脱精神困扰；停止（某人）感到焦虑或担心，减轻痛苦。
flashcards.exampleZh: 陪审团的裁决让我松了一口气。

flashcards.definition: The removal of stress or discomfort.
flashcards.example: I sighed with relief when I found out that my daughter hadn't got lost, but was waiting for me at home.
flashcards.definitionZh: 消除压力或不适。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当我发现女儿没有迷路，而是在家里等我时，我松了口气。

flashcards.definition: (definite, i.e. used with "the") Contraceptive medication, usually in the form of a pill to be taken by a woman; an oral contraceptive pill.
flashcards.example: Jane went on the pill when she left for college.
flashcards.definitionZh: （明确，即与“the”一起使用）避孕药物，通常为女性服用的药丸形式；口服避孕药。
flashcards.exampleZh: 简去上大学时继续服用避孕药。

flashcards.definition: A drug that numbs the pain in the body.
flashcards.example: This is the word Painkiller.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种可以麻痹身体疼痛的药物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是止痛药这个词。

flashcards.definition: One individual's personality, character, demeanor, or disposition.
flashcards.example: one's true self; one's better self; one's former self
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人的个性、性格、举止或性格。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个人的真实自我；更好的自己；以前的自己

flashcards.definition: Holding one's own self-interest as the standard for decision making.
flashcards.example: This is the word Selfish.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以自身利益为决策标准。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是自私这个词。

flashcards.definition: The ability to control one's desires and impulses; willpower.
flashcards.example: This is the word Self-control.
flashcards.definitionZh: 控制自己的欲望和冲动的能力；意志。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是自我控制这个词。

flashcards.definition: Influence or authority over something.
flashcards.example: The government has complete control over the situation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对某事的影响或权威。
flashcards.exampleZh: 政府完全控制局势。

flashcards.definition: To rest in a horizontal position on a surface.
flashcards.example: The book lies on the table;  the snow lies on the roof;  he lies in his coffin
flashcards.definitionZh: 水平放置在表面上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 书放在桌子上；  屋顶上有积雪；  他躺在棺材里

flashcards.definition: To rest in a horizontal position on a surface.
flashcards.example: The book lies on the table;  the snow lies on the roof;  he lies in his coffin
flashcards.wordZh: 谎言 谎言 谎言
flashcards.definitionZh: 水平放置在表面上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 书放在桌子上；  屋顶上有积雪；  他躺在棺材里

flashcards.definition: Arrangement or relationship; layout.
flashcards.example: the lay of the land
flashcards.wordZh: 躺着 躺着 躺着
flashcards.definitionZh: 安排或关系；布局。
flashcards.exampleZh: 地势

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word tight.
flashcards.example: This is the word tight.
flashcards.definitionZh: 紧这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是紧这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word tight-fitting.
flashcards.example: This is the word tight-fitting.
flashcards.definitionZh: 紧身这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是紧贴这个词。

flashcards.definition: Baggy, not tight
flashcards.example: This is the word Loose-fitting.
flashcards.definitionZh: 宽松，不紧
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是宽松这个词。

flashcards.definition: Having no weak points or flaws.
flashcards.example: We have an airtight argument they won’t be able to punch holes in.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有弱点或缺陷。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们有一个无懈可击的论点，他们无法在其中打洞。

flashcards.definition: So devised or planned as to be impossible to defeat, evade or nullify.
flashcards.example: a watertight contract; a watertight regulation
flashcards.definitionZh: 如此设计或计划以至于不可能被击败、逃避或废除。
flashcards.exampleZh: 无懈可击的合同；无懈可击的监管

flashcards.definition: Someone who contains; something that contains.
flashcards.example: This is the word Container.
flashcards.definitionZh: 包含的人；包含的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是容器这个词。

flashcards.definition: The pointing of a weapon, as a gun, a dart, or an arrow, or object, in the line of direction with the object intended to be struck; the line of fire; the direction of anything, such as a spear, a blow, a discourse, a remark, towards a particular point or object, with a view to strike or affect it.
flashcards.example: Take time with the aim of your gun.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将武器（如枪、飞镖、箭或物体）指向要攻击的物体的方向；火线；任何事物的方向，例如矛、打击、话语、言论，指向特定的点或物体，以打击或影响它。
flashcards.exampleZh: 花些时间用枪瞄准。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: To dampen; to make moderately wet
flashcards.example: to damp cloth
flashcards.definitionZh: 抑制；使适度湿润
flashcards.exampleZh: 到湿布

flashcards.definition: (modal) Truly; in fact; actually.
flashcards.example: Indeed, he made several misplays.
flashcards.definitionZh: （情态）确实；实际上;实际上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 确实，他犯了一些错误。

flashcards.definition: Special weight or forcefulness given to something considered important.
flashcards.example: He paused for emphasis before saying who had won.
flashcards.definitionZh: 给予被认为重要的事物特殊的分量或力量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在说出谁赢了之前，他停顿了一下以强调这一点。

flashcards.definition: The part of the face below the mouth.
flashcards.example: His jaw dropped in amazement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 脸部嘴巴下方的部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他惊讶得下巴都掉下来了。

flashcards.definition: Of a knitted garment: to develop a ladder as a result of a broken thread.
flashcards.example: Oh damn it, I've laddered my tights!
flashcards.definitionZh: 针织服装：因断线而形成梯子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 哦该死，我已经把我的紧身衣拉起来了！

flashcards.definition: A vertical market.
flashcards.example: We offer specialised accounting software targeting various verticals.
flashcards.definitionZh: 垂直市场。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们提供针对各个行业的专业会计软件。

flashcards.definition: To allow to enter; to grant entrance (to), whether into a place, into the mind, or into consideration
flashcards.example: A ticket admits one into a playhouse.
flashcards.definitionZh: 允许进入；允许进入（进入），无论是进入某个地方、进入思想还是进入考虑
flashcards.exampleZh: 一张门票允许人们进入剧场。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: Any treatment or experience so harsh it feels like being punished; rough handling
flashcards.example: a vehicle that can take a lot of punishment
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何严酷的待遇或经历都让人感觉像是受到了惩罚；粗鲁的处理
flashcards.exampleZh: 可以承受很多惩罚的车辆
